name: Low HP beep
notes: A soft high-low beep that repeats once a second while the player's HP bar is red (a quarter of the max HP or less), like the classic low-HP alarm. Quiet on purpose (volume 6, half of the other sounds) and on the lowest priority, so every hit, miss and cry cuts it and is heard over it; on square2, so the song's melody keeps playing. Played by the player's monster (low_hp_sfx of plr_monster and plr_waves).
